free_tier.stated: No clear public storage cap found. Platform is free SaaS on S3; documented pain point is a '1GB per day' quota on modelState (compute artifacts), not on file storage.

retention.stated: per-object-cap: none documented for plain files; 1 GB/day on modelState. Retention: indefinite for public content

egress.terms: Free to download for public projects; anonymous download of public entities is supported.

record.tooling: Python/Java/R clients (`synapseclient`), REST API, and a built-in Docker registry. Also supports custom storage locations (your own S3/GCS). Which makes it a metadata layer over someone else's bucket rather than storage itself.
record.chaining: Unlimited projects per certified user. The interesting chain is the inverse: point Synapse at a custom S3/GCS location and you get a free DOI-style sharing and permissions layer over any bucket you already have.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: none documented for plain files; 1 GB/day on modelState. Retention: indefinite for public content. Gate: upload requires 'certified user' status (a quiz), so no anonymous write path exists.
record.reliability_note: Certification gate plus no published quota means capacity is discretionary; large uploads are known to be throttled/queued without a documented ceiling. Treat quota as unverified.

evidence.proved: 'you need to be a certified user', S3-backed, no quota stated
files can live in your own S3/GCS bucket, Synapse keeps metadata
